proof: A one-slot pool refuses the second task's StartTask CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED with a typed record and nothing created; the first task's ticket is released at its end and the second starts; a one-second lease lapses under a four-second provider hold, the waiting task takes the slot, the lapsed run re-takes one at its boundary or suspends Waiting(Capacity) with CAPACITY_LOST; the pool ends empty.
audit: MISSING before: nothing bounded concurrent runs; Waiting(Capacity) had no producer.
limitations: Only the run-level ticket consumes capacity until M6.3 (subagents) and the sandbox/terminal owners; the pool is process-local; lapse is enforced at turn boundaries.
